senses.gloss:
mumukṣutva
(‘desire for मोक्ष or लिबेरतिओन्’)
------------------------------------------
According to the ṣaḍdarśanas or the six systems of इन्दिअन् फिलोसोफ्य् the real bondage for a सोउल् is its being encased in a body, whether human or non-human. Hence मोक्ष or मुक्ति is permanent लिबेरतिओन् from rebirth, and, regaining the original state. The desire for such मोक्ष is ‘mumukṣutva’ or ‘mumukṣā’ and one who possesses such a desire is a ‘mumukṣu’.
See also SĀDHANACATUṢṬAYA.
